people.name: Abraham
people.line: Patriarch, chosen by God to father His people

people.name: Isaac
people.line: Son of Abraham; father of Jacob and Esau.

translations.web: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
translations.bsb: So the child grew and was weaned, and Abraham held a great feast on the day Isaac was weaned.
translations.kjv: And the child grew, and was weaned: and Abraham made a great feast the same day that Isaac was weaned.
translations.asv: And the child grew, and was weaned. And Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.
